hero.subtitle: The ultimate Kosher Culinary Camp: hands-on cooking, baking and dessert workshops, almost daily trips, sports, Jewish pride, and the best summer energy for ages 3–12.

photos.headline: Camp photos
photos.body: Once camp begins, this section will feature fresh moments from the kitchen, trips, activities, and all the smiles in between.
photos.callout_body: During camp, new albums can be added for each day, trip, or special activity.

faq.question: What ages is camp for?
faq.answer: Kosher Culinary Camp welcomes kids ages 3–12. Activities and cooking stations are adapted by age so every camper can fully participate and succeed.

faq.question: What are drop-off and pickup times?
faq.answer: Drop-off is between 9:30–9:45 AM. Pickup is at 3:30 PM. Please be on time for both — our kitchen schedule starts promptly. Optional Before & After Care is available from 9:00 AM and until 4:00 PM.

faq.question: How does drop-off and pickup work?
faq.answer: Drop-off and pickup take place at 4050 Coolidge Hwy, Troy MI 48098. When you arrive, a staff member will greet your child at the car. At pickup, only individuals listed on your registration form are authorized to collect your camper — please have ID ready.

faq.question: How do you get to field trips?
faq.answer: We travel by school bus. Campers board right at camp and return before pickup time. All trips are supervised by staff. No separate transportation is needed from families — just drop off at camp as usual.

faq.question: Will there be security on site?
faq.answer: Yes. Kosher Culinary Camp will have security guard presence on site during camp hours, along with staff-supervised drop-off, pickup, and activities.

faq.question: Is transportation to camp provided?
faq.answer: Transportation to and from camp is not included. Families are responsible for drop-off and pickup at 4050 Coolidge Hwy, Troy MI 48098. After registration, reach out and we’ll help connect you with nearby families for carpools.

faq.question: What should my child bring?
faq.answer: Comfortable clothes they don’t mind getting messy (aprons are provided), a water bottle, any allergy medications, and a good appetite. We take care of everything else.

faq.question: My child has food allergies — is camp safe?
faq.answer: We take allergies seriously. Note all allergies during registration. Our staff reviews every camper’s needs and accommodates where possible. For severe allergies, we’ll speak with you directly before camp begins.

faq.question: Are scholarships available?
faq.answer: We believe every Jewish child deserves this experience. Limited scholarship assistance is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Contact us before registering to apply.
